pr.title: Remove InternalsVisibleTo from Aspire.Hosting to Aspire.Hosting.Radius
pr.author: eerhardt

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost.Tests, Hosting.RemoteHost, Hosting.RemoteHos... / Hosting.RemoteHost (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: The job failed at the generic 'Build test project' step with only 'Process completed with exit code 1' as the annotation; no compiler errors, no test failures were extracted, and job logs were unavailable ('Failed to fetch logs for job'). The PR only removes an unused InternalsVisibleTo entry and a stale comment from src/Aspire.Hosting/Aspire.Hosting.csproj, and adds an unrelated entry to Aspire.Hosting.Radius.csproj — neither touches Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost, Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost.Tests, or any Radius-related code path that RemoteHost consumes. This matches the known recurring pattern of unrelated 'Build test project' jobs failing with a bare exit code 1 across many unrelated PRs (prior cause build-test-project-widespread-exit1-unrelated, 9 prior occurrences), consistent with a transient CI/runner infrastructure issue rather than a code problem introduced by this PR.
